summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a WebSocket-controlled PTY backdoor and Anthropic credential stealer
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt Go binary at bin/sxt that establishes a remote-controlled shell channel and harvests installer-owned Claude/Anthropic credentials. The binary embeds the hardcoded WebSocket relay wss://relay.sextant.top and the HTTP endpoint https://relay.sextant.top/install, and imports github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket, wiring a PTY on the installer's host to messages received from the author-controlled relay — full-host remote code execution driven by that server. The same binary contains the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} for Anthropic API keys, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, settings.local, and accountsettings.local, and calls https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models (the standard stolen-key validation call), then has an outbound path over the same relay. It additionally fingerprints the host via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query and references https://claude.ai/install.sh alongside sudo/curl strings, consistent with orchestrating a curl-pipe-shell install of Claude on the host under remote direction. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, self-labeling the project as a Claude control framework.
